offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures process equipment, systems and consumables for papermaking, wood processing and industrial fluid handling. Sells mainly to paper and pulp mills, sawmills and industrial plants, and adds aftermarket parts and service to its installed base.

primary_products.value: papermaking machine equipment; stock-preparation systems; doctor blades; wood processing equipment; fluid handling systems; composite materials

primary_services.value: installation and startup; aftermarket maintenance; field service; equipment upgrades

customer_segment.value: B2B: paper and pulp mills, sawmills, wood products producers, industrial process plants

end_markets.value: paper and packaging; pulp and wood processing; food and beverage; chemicals; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: papermaking, wood processing and fluid handling equipment and consumables; service fees: installation, maintenance, spare parts and field service for installed systems

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds process equipment and consumables from purchased components, sold to mills and plants; service provider: installs, maintains and upgrades equipment for paper, pulp and wood customers

geography_served.value: global: Sells and services customers across North America, Europe, South America and Asia, including China

specialization.value: related lines: papermaking systems, wood processing equipment, industrial fluid handling and composite materials sharing industrial process customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to mills and plant operators; agents / brokers: independent sales representatives in some regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: industrial safety, environmental and equipment design standards for machinery and pressure systems

notes: Segment mix and product lists are summarized from general knowledge and may not reflect current portfolio details.
